story:
Ethan loved trains more than almost anything. His favorite was a bright red engine with three shiny cars that rattled cheerfully along the tracks. [emotion:QT/happy] One Saturday morning, Ethan went to build the longest train track he had ever made. [gesture:stretching] He stretched it across the rough carpet, through the chair legs, and around his big blue beanbag. But when he reached the last corner, he saw the problem — the curved piece was missing. [emotion:QT/surprised] [emotion:QT/sad] Ethan felt a heavy, sinking feeling in his chest because the whole track looked incomplete without it.

His neighbor Mia knocked on the door while Ethan was staring at the gap. "Maybe we can find another way around," she said cheerfully, crouching beside him. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:nodding-yes] They worked together, taking turns placing pieces, until they discovered three straight pieces made a gentle curve. Finally, the red engine chugged all the way around. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan laughed because it had worked, and Mia cheered. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:clapping] Ethan thought she was the best kind of friend — the kind who stays and helps. [emotion:QT/calm]

scenes: Ethan kneeling on a carpet surrounded by train tracks that wind through chair legs and around a big blue beanbag, staring at a gap in the track where a curved piece is missing, his bright red engine and three shiny cars waiting nearby.

Ethan and his neighbor Mia crouching together on the carpet, placing train track pieces side by side, with the completed track now forming a full loop and the red engine chugging around it as both children laugh and cheer.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his train track?
questions.correct_answer: A good friend stays and helps you solve a problem
wrong_answers: Trains are the greatest vehicles in the whole world
You should always have three extra track pieces ready

questions.question: Where did Ethan stretch his train track while he was building it on Saturday morning?
questions.correct_answer: Across the carpet, through chair legs, and around his beanbag
wrong_answers: Through the hallway and around the kitchen table
Around his bed and through the closet door

questions.question: After Mia arrived, what did she and Ethan discover while they were working together to fix the track?
questions.correct_answer: Three straight pieces could make a gentle curve
wrong_answers: They found the missing curved piece under the beanbag
They chose to make the track shorter instead

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt that heavy, sinking feeling in his chest when he reached the last corner of the track?
questions.correct_answer: Because the missing piece meant his whole track was ruined
wrong_answers: Because he thought Mia was going to take his train away
Because he was tired and really wanted to stop building

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Mia had not knocked on the door while Ethan was staring at the gap in the track?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan might have stayed sad and never finished the track
wrong_answers: Ethan would have quickly found three straight pieces on his own
Ethan would have thrown the train and the track in the trash

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to let Mia help him with the track?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help can turn a hard problem into something you solve together.
wrong_answers: Letting someone else take over means the problem gets solved much faster on its own.
Waiting quietly for someone to notice your problem is the best way to get help.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Being patient and trying a new way often gets you to where you want to go.
wrong_answers: Sticking to your original plan is always the best way to finish what you started.
If the right piece is missing, it is better to stop and wait until you find it.

questions.question: What did Mia show us by what she did?
questions.correct_answer: Good friends make hard things feel easier and more fun.
wrong_answers: The best friends are the ones who already know how to fix every problem you have.
Having a friend nearby means you never have to do any of the hard work yourself.

takeaways: Asking a friend for help can turn a hard problem into something you solve together.
Being patient and trying a new way often gets you to where you want to go.
Good friends make hard things feel easier and more fun.
